title: Monthly vs Daily
description: The same set of shipments should roll up consistently whether a dispatcher views them day by day or month by month — the totals must agree even as the bucket shape changes.
successCondition: Book at least 2 shipments that fall in the same calendar month (UTC). GET /api/reporting/summary with groupBy=day over a window covering them returns buckets with period in YYYY-MM-DD format, summing to the same totalShipments and totalRevenueCents as GET /api/reporting/summary with groupBy=month over the identical from/to window, where the month buckets use YYYY-MM format.
hints: totalShipments and totalRevenueCents are computed once over the whole matched row set, independent of groupBy — they should be identical between the two calls even though buckets looks different.
Keep timeZone at its UTC default for both calls so you're isolating groupBy as the only variable.
